citationText: 5. At NAB two years ago , a major Canadian chip manufacturer demonstrated a prototype chip driving professional 1080i down 2000 ft of RG-6 (1694A) with a perfect eye pattern at the end. The formula result is 400 ft further emphasizing that these are safe distances and real-world applications could go much farther. If one wishes to go farther than the calculated distance, then those cables should be individually tested for bit errors or eye patterns.
